One of the UK’s leading eCommerce fulfilment specialists, J&J Global Fulfilment has opened a second fulfilment centre in Columbus, Ohio, more than doubling the company’s footprint in the city and marking a significant step forward in its long-term commitment to the US market. The new 155,000-square-foot facility joins J&J’s existing Columbus site, together providing over 250,000 square feet of capacity and the infrastructure to support higher volumes, a growing client base and more complex fulfilment requirements. Built from the ground up with futureproofing in mind, the new centre has been designed with the headroom required for automation technology and a warehouse layout optimised for high-volume, high-efficiency processing. The opening forms part of a wider programme of investment in J&J’s US operations – spanning infrastructure, people and technology – made possible by J&J’s acquisition by the QLS Group in November 2025. J&J first established a US presence in Columbus in 2016, later expanding with a second site in Las Vegas in 2022. The new operation includes two leased warehouse facilities in the Liberty area totaling more than 830,000 square feet. The company will also make a multi-million-dollar investment in equipment, infrastructure and automated trailer loading and unloading technology to support the operation. Submitted Photo Judith Munson Contributor October 5, 2026 APPLETON – RGL Logistics is making moves again. The Green Bay-based company recently completed construction on a new warehouse at its Appleton campus, marking its 29th building to join its three-campus network. Michelle Wellens, director of transportation solutions and marketing, said the new building adds 427,500 square feet to the company’s total footprint of more than 4 million square feet, which covers all three RGL sites in Neenah, Green Bay and Appleton. Wellens said the warehouse was built to create additional capacity and flexibility on RGL’s Appleton campus, while continuing to respond to customers’ needs. “As our business and customer partnerships have grown, we saw a need for additional warehousing and supply chain capacity that would position us not only for what is needed today, but for what our customers may need in the future,” she said. Wellens said the new construction includes a centralized, gated driver check-in area that enhances safety, security and efficiency for RGL’s team members.
